extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

items.notes: 附本服装三视图 art_doll_gear_bonehorn_ref 与人台动作条 art_doll_mannequin_h_ride 作参照，姿势逐格对齐人台（头部与手部偏差不超过 1 像素）。只画骑手，跨坐时大腿近乎水平，臀部所在的水平线就是鞍位锚点；双手握缰的位置在腹前。

subject.zh: 拾遗作拼甲：千年前的古金属胸片（金属灰）上镂空出拱门形的孔，和新打的铆钉、补丁拼在一起；右肩甲比左肩甲大一圈；甲下灰扑扑的厚布衫（主色）；裹腿布（副色）；皮护手与靴（皮革棕）；腰间挂防灰面布（点缀绿）
subject.en: Salvage patchwork armor: ancient metal chest pieces from a thousand years ago (metal gray) pierced with arch-shaped holes, pieced together with new rivets and patches; the right pauldron one size larger than the left; a dusty thick cloth shirt underneath (primary red); leg wraps (secondary blue); leather gloves and boots (leather brown); an ash veil hanging at the waist (accent green)

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.zh: 倒木作林丝衣：贴身的林丝长衫（主色）垂到大腿，肩上叠一片不上漆的木纹硬革护肩（皮革棕）；胸前斜系一条窄披带（副色）；腰间藤编腰带束住，挂木扣（点缀绿）；紧身裤配软底长靴；衣缘有年轮状同心圆纹；没有金属

subject.en: Fallenwood forest-silk garb: a close-fitting forest-silk tunic (primary red) to the thighs, an unvarnished wood-grain hardened leather pauldron layered on the shoulder (leather brown); a narrow sash tied across the chest (secondary blue); a woven vine belt with wooden toggles (accent green); tight trousers with soft-soled tall boots; tree-ring concentric patterns along the hems; no metal at all

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.en: Coarse clothes of a Lotha tenant farmer: a hip-length pullover coarse shirt (primary red) laced at the neck with twine, sleeves rolled up; an old sleeveless wool vest over it (secondary blue); loose coarse trousers rolled to the calf; a twine belt with a small cloth pouch; wooden-soled clogs (leather brown); patches on the shoulder and knees (accent green)

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.en: Clothes of woodcutters and hunters: a long-sleeved coarse wool top (primary red) under a fur vest (accent green) strapped shut across the chest; leather wrist guards (leather brown); thick wool trousers (secondary blue) bound with leather strips; high leather boots; an axe loop and a small knife on the belt

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

items.notes: 居民服装（标准体型，出 8 条动作条）。附人台三视图 art_doll_mannequin_h_ref 作参照，只画服装、鞋与腰带。覆盖：北境难民 tpl_refugee_north、散居遗民 tpl_hidden_gatefolk、乞丐与墙外营地居民；手背不画任何纹。键色分区要清楚，相邻两块不用同一种键色；风格锚只取气质，颜色以键色为准。

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

items.notes: 附本服装三视图 art_doll_res_burgher_ref 与人台动作条 art_doll_mannequin_h_death 作参照，姿势逐格对齐人台（头部与手部偏差不超过 1 像素）。倒地后躺平的两帧完全一致，便于反放成起身。

subject.en: Short work clothes of dock porters and fishers: a short-sleeved coarse vest (primary red) showing strong arms; loose trousers rolled above the knees (secondary blue); a wide cloth sash wound twice around the waist (accent green); a thick leather pad on one shoulder for hauling cargo (leather brown); bare feet or straw sandals

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.zh: 金湾人的衣着：鲜艳的宽袖短上衣（主色）敞开前襟，内穿条纹背心（副色）；腰间缠一条长长的彩色腰巾（点缀绿），一端垂到膝；宽松灯笼裤收在小腿；软皮便鞋（皮革棕）；腰巾挂一串钥匙与小秤（金属灰）
subject.en: Clothes of the Gold Bay folk: a bright wide-sleeved short jacket (primary red) worn open over a striped vest (secondary blue); a long colorful sash wound at the waist (accent green) with one end hanging to the knee; loose trousers gathered at the calf; soft leather slippers (leather brown); a bunch of keys and a little balance scale hanging from the sash (metal gray)

subject.en: Red Anvil smith wear for the small body (a dwarf): a sleeveless thick leather short jacket (leather brown) showing burly arms, a ring of ore-vein-like rivet dots along its edges (metal gray); a thick cloth shirt underneath (primary red); a wide belt (secondary blue) carrying a contract-name copper plaque (accent green, engraved patterns only); thick cloth trousers and steel-toed boots

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

items.notes: 附本服装三视图 art_doll_fac_oneeye_bandit_ref 与人台动作条 art_doll_mannequin_h_death 作参照，姿势逐格对齐人台（头部与手部偏差不超过 1 像素）。倒地后躺平的两帧完全一致，便于反放成起身。左向由右向镜像，左右不对称的部位在左向会换边，这是允许的。

subject.en: Uniform of Lotha town and city guards: a thigh-length quilted gambeson (primary red) under a slit sleeveless tabard (secondary blue) with a shield-shaped heraldry area on the chest (accent green, graphic only); iron pauldrons and bracers (metal gray); a wide leather belt with a sword frog (leather brown); trousers and laced tall boots

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.en: Ritual garb of a Windfang shaman: a calf-length hide robe (leather brown) with a cape hung with bone plates and feathers over the shoulders (primary red); many colored cords wound at the waist (secondary blue alternating with accent green) with small bone charms (metal gray); leather cords on wrists and ankles; bare feet; a tail opening at the back hem

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

extra.zh: 穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，姿势与人台的同名动作条逐格一致；保留人台的灰色光头，不画头发与头饰；服装用键色：主色纯红系、副色纯蓝系、皮革棕系、金属灰系、点缀绿系；双手空握，不拿武器。
extra.en: Worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, matching the mannequin's strip of the same action frame by frame; keep the mannequin's gray bald head, no hair or headwear; outfit in key colors: primary pure red tones, secondary pure blue tones, leather brown, metal gray, accents green; hands empty in a grip, no weapon.

subject.en: Felt hat: a soft round-crowned felt hat (primary red key color), the brim turned up on the character left, a short feather in the hatband (secondary blue key color)

extra.zh: 第 1 行画头饰挡在脸前与头顶的部分，第 2 行画在后脑后面的部分；只画头饰本身，不画头与头发。这个部件左右不对称：第 4 列朝左的一格要按人物真实的左侧来画，不能直接镜像第 2 列。
extra.en: Row 1 holds the parts of the headwear in front of the face and on top of the head, row 2 the parts behind the head; draw only the headwear itself, not the head or hair. This part is asymmetric: the fourth column facing left must show the real left side of the character, not a mirror of column 2.

subject.zh: 标准人形（人族、精灵、兽人浅相、门民、灰魔）的眼与嘴：眼是竖向 3 像素的深褐小块（#3a2a22），上端 1 像素高光（#f0ece0）；嘴是深红褐色（#7a3a32）；痛苦时眉心一道细线
subject.en: Eyes and mouths for the standard humanoid (humans, elves, light-phase beastfolk, gatefolk, Ashkin): eyes are vertical 3-pixel dark brown blocks (#3a2a22) with a 1-pixel highlight at the top (#f0ece0); mouths in dark reddish brown (#7a3a32); a thin line between the brows when in pain

subject.zh: 小型体型（孩童、半身人、矮人）的眼与嘴：眼更圆、间距更宽，是竖向 2 像素的深褐小块（#3a2a22）加一个亮点（矮人的眼像映着火光）；嘴更小，1 到 2 像素（#7a3a32）
subject.en: Eyes and mouths for the small body (children, halflings, dwarves): rounder, wider-set eyes made of vertical 2-pixel dark brown blocks (#3a2a22) with one bright dot (dwarf eyes look like they catch firelight); smaller mouths of 1 to 2 pixels (#7a3a32)

subject.en: Short cape: a waist-length short cape (primary red) tied at the collar with a cord, its lining (secondary blue) flipping out at one corner when it swings; straight edges, no patterns

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：下摆向后掀起，内衬翻出一角。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the hem lifts backward and a corner of the lining flips out.

subject.en: Travel cloak: a thick wool travel cloak falling to the calves (primary red), a round clasp at the collar (metal gray), a seam down the middle of the back, a worn fuzzy hem edge (secondary blue)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：下摆随步伐向一侧摆开。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the hem swings out to one side with the stride.

subject.en: Black Ridge bearhide mantle: a whole black bear hide draped from both shoulders to behind the knees, the bear head pelt resting on one shoulder and the two forepaws hanging over the chest; fur in pure yellow tones (recolored to near-black bear fur in game) with a darker ridge line along the spine; a leather strap at the collar (leather brown)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：毛皮下摆随步伐轻轻晃动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the fur hem sways gently with the stride.

subject.en: Ragged cloak: a tattered old cloak (primary red) with its hem torn into uneven strips and two patches on the back (secondary blue); worn by refugees, scavengers and drifters

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：布条随风散开飘动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the strips spread and flutter in the wind.

subject.en: Quiver: a long leather quiver slung diagonally on the back (leather brown) with a sheaf of fletched arrows showing at the top (feathers primary red), the strap running from the right shoulder to the left hip (secondary blue), an iron band around the bottom (metal gray)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：箭袋随步伐轻轻颠动，箭羽错开。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the quiver bounces lightly with the stride and the fletchings shift.

subject.en: Backpack: a canvas rucksack (primary red) with a bedroll strapped on top (secondary blue), a water flask and a small pot hanging at the sides (metal gray), leather brown straps

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：挂在两侧的水壶与小锅晃动。

subject.en: Firewood frame: a wooden carrying frame (leather brown) loaded with a big bundle of split firewood in pale wood color (#b48a58), cinched tight with rope (secondary blue); used by woodcutters and villagers

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：柴捆随步伐上下颠一下。

subject.en: Back basket: a round woven rattan basket (leather brown) filled with herbs and flowering twigs (accent green), the straps wrapped with cloth (primary red)

subject.en: Slung round shield: a wooden round shield carried on the back, its face in primary red, an iron rim and central boss (metal gray), hung diagonally by a leather strap (leather brown)

subject.en: Slung greatsword: a two-handed greatsword carried diagonally on the back, the scabbard leather brown, guard and pommel metal gray, the grip wrapped in cloth (primary red); the hilt shows above the right shoulder

subject.en: Bell-road pack (small body): a bulging halfling pack (primary red) with small copper bells hanging at its four corners (metal gray) and a rolled blanket strapped on top (secondary blue); placed on the back of the small-body mannequin

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：四角的小铃随步伐晃起来。

subject.zh: 狼尾（兽人浅相）：粗而蓬松的狼尾，尾尖颜色浅一阶，自然下垂并略向后翘；毛发纯黄系
subject.en: Wolf tail (light-phase beastfolk): a thick bushy wolf tail, the tip one step lighter, hanging naturally and curving slightly backward; fur in pure yellow tones

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：尾巴向一侧甩起。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the tail swishes up to one side.

subject.zh: 贵族披风：半圆长披风（主色）垂到脚踝，领口一圈宽毛皮（毛发纯黄系），内衬绸缎（副色），一对圆形披风扣（金属灰系）
subject.en: Noble mantle: a half-circle long mantle (primary red) falling to the ankles with a wide fur collar (pure yellow fur tones), a satin lining (secondary blue), and a pair of round clasps (metal gray)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：长摆向后拖起一道弧。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the long train lifts back in an arc.

subject.zh: 审判庭白披风：垂到脚踝的长披风（主色，游戏里换成白），内衬绣着细密的光环几何纹（副色），领口银扣（金属灰系）
subject.en: Inquisition white cape: a long cape falling to the ankles (primary red, recolored to white in game), its lining embroidered with a dense halo geometric pattern (secondary blue), silver clasps at the collar (metal gray)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：披风向后扬起，露出内衬的纹。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the cape flares back and shows the patterned lining.

subject.zh: 骑士长披风：骑士与圣骑士的长披风（主色），背后正中一个盾形纹章区（副色，只有图形），下摆平整，挂在两侧肩甲的扣上（金属灰系）
subject.en: Knight cape: the long cape of knights and paladins (primary red) with a shield-shaped heraldry area in the middle of the back (secondary blue, graphic only), an even hem, hooked onto clasps on both pauldrons (metal gray)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：下摆随步伐摆动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the hem swings with the stride.

subject.zh: 狐尾（兽人浅相）：又长又蓬的狐尾，尾尖一截明显变浅接近白，向上弯成一道弧；毛发纯黄系
subject.en: Fox tail (light-phase beastfolk): a long fluffy fox tail with a clearly paler tip close to white, curving upward in an arc; fur in pure yellow tones

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：尾巴摆向另一侧，尾尖卷起。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the tail swings to the other side with the tip curling.

subject.zh: 翼魔蝠翼：一对蝠翼，骨架细长（副色），翼缘有小爪，翼膜薄（主色，换成皮膜色）；静止时半收在身后
subject.en: Wing-fiend bat wings: a pair of bat wings with long slender bones (secondary blue) and small claws at the leading edges, thin membranes (primary red, recolored to the skin-membrane color); half folded behind the back at rest

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：双翼张开一半，翼膜鼓起。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the wings open halfway with the membranes billowing.

subject.zh: 行炉折叠炉架（小型体型）：铁框（金属灰系）收拢成一个方架，上面绑着风箱（皮革棕系）、小铁砧与一袋炭（主色布袋）；位置按小型体型人台的背部
subject.en: Wanderforge folding forge rack (small body): an iron frame (metal gray) folded into a square rack strapped with a bellows (leather brown), a small anvil and a bag of charcoal (primary red cloth bag); placed on the back of the small-body mannequin

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：炉架随步伐颠一下，炭袋晃动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the rack jolts once with the stride and the charcoal bag swings.

subject.zh: 卷轴筒：斜背的长卷轴筒（皮革棕系），两端包铜盖（金属灰系），背带（主色）上挂一个墨水瓶（副色）
subject.en: Scroll case: a long scroll tube slung diagonally (leather brown) with copper caps at both ends (metal gray), an ink bottle (secondary blue) hanging from the strap (primary red)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：墨水瓶随步伐晃动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the ink bottle swings with the stride.

subject.zh: 背旗：将领背后插的一面窄长背旗，旗杆（皮革棕系）从背后竖起高过头顶，旗面（主色）上只有一个几何图形（副色），没有字
subject.en: Back banner: a narrow tall banner fixed on a general back, the pole (leather brown) rising above the head, the flag (primary red) bearing only one geometric figure (secondary blue), no letters

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：旗面向一侧飘起。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the flag streams out to one side.

subject.zh: 帝国短披风：军团的短披风（主色，换成深红）从双肩垂到臀下，用两枚圆别针（金属灰系）扣在肩甲上，边缘一道深色滚边（副色）
subject.en: Legion short cloak: a legion short cloak (primary red, recolored to deep red) falling from both shoulders to below the hips, pinned to the pauldrons with two round brooches (metal gray), a dark piping along its edge (secondary blue)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：披风随步伐向后掀动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the cloak flips back with the stride.

subject.zh: 精灵羽饰披肩：一件短披肩（主色）上缀着一排长羽（副色），羽根用细绳（点缀绿）系住
subject.en: Elven feather shawl: a short shawl (primary red) fringed with a row of long feathers (secondary blue) tied at the quills with thin cord (accent green)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：长羽一根根错开飘起。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the long feathers lift and part one by one.

subject.zh: 豹猫长尾（斑影部）：细长的尾巴，末端略粗，带深色斑点（斑点暗一阶），尾尖上翘成钩；毛发纯黄系
subject.en: Leopard-cat long tail (Dappleshade tribe): a long slender tail slightly thicker at the end with dark spots (one step darker), the tip curling up into a hook; fur in pure yellow tones

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：尾巴弯成 S 形慢慢摆动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the tail bends into an S and sways slowly.

subject.zh: 熊短尾（岩掌部）：短圆的熊尾，几乎藏在毛里，只露出一团；毛发纯黄系；位置按高大体型人台的臀部
subject.en: Bear stub tail (Rockpaw tribe): a short round bear tail almost hidden in the fur, showing only a tuft; fur in pure yellow tones; placed at the hips of the large-body mannequin

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：短尾轻轻一抖。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the stub tail gives a small twitch.

subject.zh: 野猪细尾（獠牙部）：细长的尾巴，末端一撮硬鬃，常卷成一个小圈；毛发纯黄系；位置按高大体型人台的臀部
subject.en: Boar thin tail (Tusk tribe): a thin tail with a tuft of stiff bristles at the end, often curled into a little loop; fur in pure yellow tones; placed at the hips of the large-body mannequin

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：尾巴甩直又卷回。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the tail flicks straight and curls back.

subject.zh: 兔团尾（疾耳部）：一团圆圆的短绒尾，紧贴在臀部上方，像一个小绒球；毛发纯黄系（游戏里换成白或灰）
subject.en: Rabbit puff tail (Swiftear tribe): a round little ball of soft fur sitting close above the hips like a pompom; pure yellow fur tones (recolored to white or gray in game)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：团尾随步伐一跳。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the puff tail bounces with the stride.

subject.zh: 牛尾（长角部）：细长的尾杆自然下垂到膝弯，末端一簇长毛分成两三绺，甩起来像一根鞭子；毛发纯黄系
subject.en: Ox tail (Longhorn tribe): a long thin tail hanging naturally to the backs of the knees, the long hair tuft at its end split into two or three locks, flicking like a whip; fur in pure yellow tones

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：尾端的长毛甩向一侧。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the hair tuft at the end swings to one side.

subject.zh: 信筒：疾耳部信使背的长信筒（皮革棕系），筒口防雨铜盖（金属灰系），背带（主色）上系一根彩绳（副色）
subject.en: Message tube: a long message tube carried by Swiftear couriers (leather brown) with a rainproof copper cap (metal gray), a colored cord (secondary blue) tied to the strap (primary red)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：信筒随步伐上下颠动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the tube bounces up and down with the stride.

subject.zh: 萨满骨饰背架：小木架（皮革棕系）上挂着串起的骨片与兽牙（主色，换成骨白）和几根彩绳（副色）
subject.en: Shaman bone rack: a small wooden frame (leather brown) hung with strung bone plates and beast teeth (primary red, recolored to bone white) and a few colored cords (secondary blue)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：骨串互相碰撞着摆动。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the bone strings knock together and swing.

subject.zh: 夜纱长斗篷：夜境的薄纱长斗篷（主色，换成近黑的深灰），薄透感用细密排线表现，不画半透明；下摆分成几缕像烟，边缘一道暗红（副色）
subject.en: Night gauze cloak: a long thin gauze cloak of the Night Realm (primary red, recolored to near-black dark gray), its sheerness shown with fine hatching rather than transparency; the hem splits into several smoke-like strands with a dark red edge (secondary blue)

extra.zh: 第 2 行的摆动：下摆的几缕向后飘散。
extra.en: Row 2 sway: the hem strands drift back and spread.
